description: This file defines an interface for a factory that creates blob container clients for Azure Blob Storage, specifically for use within Orleans grains, including methods to retrieve blob containers based on GrainId and to initialize dependencies asynchronously.

classes.name: IBlobContainerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating blob container clients associated with specific GrainId instances, and initializing dependencies asynchronously.

methods.name: GetBlobContainerClient
methods.description: Returns a BlobContainerClient for the specified GrainId.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes dependencies asynchronously using a BlobServiceClient and a CancellationToken.
